# Hearthstone Foundation Grant (Renewal)

- **What it is:** Keystone's largest institutional grant — a **restricted** grant underwriting
  roughly half the [After-School Tutoring Program](../projects/after-school-tutoring.md) budget.
  Prior award ~$600K/year.
- **Owner:** [Daniela Cruz](../people/daniela-cruz.md); funder contact is Program Officer
  [Diane Alcott](../people/diane-alcott.md).
- **Status:** **DECLINED (updated 2026-07-15).** The Hearthstone Foundation declined the FY27
  renewal as it shifts strategy toward early-childhood funding. **This supersedes the earlier
  "verbally committed / likely" read from the spring board meeting** — that optimistic status is
  stale and no longer holds.

## Timeline
- Spring 2026: [Gregory Lang](../people/gregory-lang.md) reported the renewal as **verbally
  committed / likely** (see [2026-05-12 log](../log/2026-05-12-spring-board-meeting.md)).
- 2026-07-15: Diane Alcott confirmed the renewal was **declined** (see
  [2026-07-15 log](../log/2026-07-15-grants-update.md)).

## Open items
- **Overdue: the Q2 grant report to Hearthstone** is still owed — sending it protects the future
  relationship (see [commitments](../commitments.md)).
- Identify replacement funding for the tutoring program; consider a re-approach scoped to
  Hearthstone's new early-childhood focus later.
